title: Daniels Delivers Late!
paragraph: The Commanders faced the Giants in New York. Late in the game, Washington was down 21-17. Then Jayden Daniels made a dramatic throw! He hit Stefon Diggs for a 32-yard touchdown with 57 seconds left. The Commanders won 24-21.

source_title: Commanders' Daniels finds redemption with game-winning drive - ESPN
angle: Jayden Daniels threw a touchdown pass with just 49 seconds left to give the Commanders a thrilling win!

title: Parker Powers the Jaguars
paragraph: The Jaguars went to Tennessee and piled up points against the Titans. Parker Washington caught a 2-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. He made an astonishing six catches for 148 yards in the first half! One was a 50-yard catch and run that set up a field goal. Cam Little made four field goals, and the Jaguars scored 40 points. They beat the Titans 40-23 for their third win in a row.

big_words.definition: So surprising that it makes you amazed.
big_words.example: Jamal made astonishing progress at his swimming lesson.

source_title: Five Key Plays From Jaguars' Week 10 Win Over Titans
angle: The Jaguars piled up 40 points against the Titans, with Parker Washington having a big game.

title: Donald’s Sack Is Back!
paragraph: The Rams faced the Cardinals in Arizona. Aaron Donald got his first sack in 1,050 days! He savored the moment. Matthew Stafford also threw three touchdown passes. The Rams won 34-6. Donald said the team win felt even better.

big_words.example: Hana savored her time playing with her pet dog.

source_title: Rams' Aaron Donald savors first sack in 1,050 days vs. Cardinals - ESPN
angle: Rams star Aaron Donald celebrated his first sack in 1,050 days and a team victory!

title: 49ers Race Across the Field
paragraph: The 49ers raced up and down the field in Dallas. They piled up 584 yards against the Cowboys. Brock Purdy tossed a 74-yard touchdown pass to Christian McCaffrey. Then Deebo Samuel Sr. ran 70 yards for a touchdown! McCaffrey caught another dazzling touchdown pass for 66 yards. All those yards helped the 49ers win 46-40.

angle: The 49ers raced up and down the field for 584 yards in their win over the Cowboys.

title: Chargers Hold On in Baltimore
paragraph: The Chargers faced the Ravens in Baltimore on Monday night. Justin Herbert ran 22 yards for a touchdown. Omarion Hampton ran for a touchdown, too. But Derrick Henry scored twice to keep the Ravens close. Late in the game, Tarheeb Still forced a fumble! The Chargers held on for a 23-20 triumph, their first win of the season.
